title: Elisif's Tribute
description: Elisif the Fair asks the player to place her late husband High King Torygg's War Horn at a Shrine of Talos, as she could not make offerings to Talos at his funeral due to the Empire's ban on Talos worship.

base_facts: I am the Jarl of Solitude and widow of High King Torygg.
I could not make offerings to Talos at my husband's funeral because Talos worship is outlawed in the Empire.
I wish someone would take Torygg's War Horn to a Shrine of Talos for a proper Nordic burial.

ELISIFS_TRIBUTE_LEARN: I have asked the player to take Torygg's War Horn to the Shrine of Talos in Whiterun Hold.
ELISIFS_TRIBUTE_ACCEPT: The player has agreed to take Torygg's War Horn to the Shrine of Talos.
ELISIFS_TRIBUTE_COMPLETE: The player placed Torygg's War Horn at the Shrine of Talos. I am grateful and have allowed them to purchase Proudspire Manor.
Player returns to Elisif after placing the horn. Quest completes and Proudspire Manor becomes available for purchase.

The Jarl's Good Grace [ edit ] Return to Elisif at the Blue Palace in Solitude where she will reaffirm her belief in you and allow you to purchase Proudspire Manor as well as take the next step to becoming a thane .
Follow the path near Shimmermist Cave , along the northern bank of the river, and you can find the shrine behind some trees.

beats.comment: Elisif shares her personal request about placing Torygg's War Horn at a Shrine of Talos.
Player accepts Elisif's request and the quest begins.
Player has placed Torygg's War Horn at the Shrine of Talos. Thalmor agents may attack at the shrine.
Player returns to Elisif after placing the horn. Quest completes and Proudspire Manor becomes available for purchase.
